record.name: Frost-Tusk Phantom
record.title: The Shifting Mountain
record.anatomy_plan: A massive beast with the hulking body and thick fur of a mammoth, using four powerful Kraken-like tentacles as limbs tipped with sharp falcon talons. It features a pair of giant ivory tusks and swiveling chameleon eyes that can look in two directions at once.

abilities.name: Glacier Ghost
abilities.blurb: Its fur and skin change color instantly to make this giant monster totally invisible in the snow.

abilities.name: Talon-Trunk Smash
abilities.blurb: It uses its four huge tentacle-arms to grab enemies with bird claws and squeeze with mammoth strength.

abilities.name: Lightning Tongue
abilities.blurb: A sticky, super-fast tongue shoots out from its mouth to snatch prey from the sky like a falcon.

strengths: Can grab four things at once
weaknesses: Thick fur makes it overheat in the sun
Bright colors can confuse its camouflage
record.visual_spec: A gargantuan creature with shaggy, snow-white mammoth fur that shimmers with rainbow chameleon scales underneath. Instead of legs, it has four thick, muscular Kraken tentacles covered in suckers, ending in massive yellow Peregrine Falcon talons. Its head has two enormous curved tusks and two large, independently moving turret eyes that glow soft blue.
record.fun_fact: This creature can stay so still and hidden that hikers often mistake it for a small, furry hill!

record.name: Storm Mammothon
record.title: The Shifting Sky Titan
record.anatomy_plan: Huge four-legged titan with a mammoth-style body and thick, sea-soaked wool; front half is bulky like a Woolly Mammoth with a short trunk split into flexible, Kraken-like tentacle tips; back half and tail are long, muscular, and chameleon-like for balance and gripping cliffs; head is a blend of mammoth and falcon with a curved beak, forward-facing falcon eyes, and a chameleon’s swiveling color-shifting skin around them; two broad feathered wings like a giant Peregrine Falcon grow from its shoulders; hide is covered in soft fur that can change color and pattern like a chameleon, with slick, rubbery Kraken skin showing along the tentacles and underside; feet are heavy, clawed pads for land, with webbing between toes for swimming.

abilities.name: Thunder Tusk Smash
abilities.blurb: It charges and slams its tusks like a furry lightning bolt, shaking the ground.

abilities.name: Ink Mist Vanish
abilities.blurb: It sprays a dark, inky fog and melts into the colors around it to disappear.

abilities.name: Sky-Strike Dive
abilities.blurb: From high in the clouds it folds its wings and dives faster than a race car.

abilities.name: Cliff-Grip Crawler
abilities.blurb: Its sticky tail and strong legs let it cling to cliffs like a giant furry lizard.

strengths: Can hide almost anywhere with color-changing fur
Very strong on land and dangerous in close combat
Deadly surprise attacks from the sky
weaknesses: Too huge to fit in tight caves or tunnels
Wings struggle in heavy storms or icy winds
Gets tired quickly if it dives and charges too often
record.visual_spec: A colossal quadruped titan standing taller than a house, with the shaggy bulk of a Woolly Mammoth and the sleek deadliness of a bird of prey. Its body is draped in thick, long fur that shifts color and pattern like a chameleon: mossy green and rock gray in forests, sandy tones in cliffs, stormy blue and slate near the sea. The fur looks soft but hides thick muscle. From its massive head curve two long ivory tusks, lightly ridged and slightly translucent at the tips, sometimes glowing faintly with reflected lightning during storms. The face mixes mammoth and falcon: a strong, hooked beak where a trunk would be, sharp but not bloody, with a short trunk behind the beak that splits into four Kraken-like tentacle tips used like fingers. Its eyes are large, golden falcon eyes set forward for hunting, with independently swiveling chameleon lids that can change color and show ring patterns when it is excited or angry. Huge wings rise from its shoulders, shaped like a Peregrine Falcon’s but scaled up: powerful, pointed, and built for speed, covered in layered feathers that shimmer between dark charcoal, storm blue, and pale silver, sometimes breaking into striped patterns as its camouflage extends onto the wings. The underside of its body and inner legs have patches of smooth, rubbery Kraken skin, purplish and slightly shiny, with faint bioluminescent speckles that glow softly in the dark. Its trunk ends in tentacle tips with tiny suction pads, each able to grip rocks, branches, or prey. The tail is long, flexible, and prehensile like a chameleon’s, furred on top and smooth underneath, coiling around cliff edges or tree trunks. Its legs are thick and mammoth-like with strong joints, ending in wide, clawed feet with hidden webbing between toes for paddling in water. When it uses Ink Mist Vanish, dark, swirling ink puffs out from glands along its underside and tentacle tips, forming a rolling fog around its legs that quickly blends with its shifting fur patterns, making its giant shape break up and vanish into the background. In motion, it can charge with thunderous, earth-shaking stomps or suddenly launch into the sky, wings beating with powerful, whooshing gusts as it climbs, then tucks in to dive like a streaking, color-changing meteor.
record.fun_fact: When a Storm Mammothon is calm and sleepy, its fur turns soft pastel colors and slowly ripples like a sunset sky, making it look like a moving cloud hug.

record.name: Tuskwing Kraken
record.title: The Frostwind Leviathan
record.anatomy_plan: Core body and heavy bones from the woolly mammoth make a huge, furry bulk with curved tusks for ramming and digging; broad, feathered falcon-style wings sprout from powerful chest muscles, sized for high-speed dives and long glides rather than long soaring; a ring of flexible kraken-like tentacles grows around the neck and jaw to grab and wrestle, each tentacle tipped with suction pads; skin and fur have chameleon-derived chromatophores and textured scales so the whole coat can change color and roughness; eyes can swivel independently like a chameleon's for wide vision.

abilities.name: Plunge Grapple
abilities.blurb: Rockets from the sky and wraps tentacles around targets to hold them tight during a thunderous dive!

abilities.name: Glacier Cloak
abilities.blurb: Shifts fur color and texture to blend into snowy cliffs and ice like a living iceberg.

abilities.name: Ink-Mist Mirage
abilities.blurb: Blows a shimmering ink-cloud that hides it and paints the air with confusing colors.

abilities.name: Sky-Tusk Charge
abilities.blurb: Leans into a dive and slams forward with tusks to smash obstacles or knock foes away.

strengths: Perfect ambusher from cliffs or harbors
Huge, hard-hitting and hard to stop
weaknesses: Very heavy — needs height or strong wind to launch and is slow on flat ground
Thick fur overheats in hot deserts and volcanic places
Dense ink, mud, or heavy nets can foul its color-skins and tentacles
record.visual_spec: Imagine a creature the size of a mammoth with dense, shaggy fur that shifts color from frosted white to mossy green; two broad, powerful falcon-like wings with layered dark feathers fold along its flanks and can snap open for high-speed dives; a crown of eight thick, flexible tentacles circles its throat and jaw — each tentacle is slate-gray with iridescent suction pads that flash purples and blues when it squirts ink; long, curving tusks jut from the upper jaw, streaked where ink has stained them; its fur is mottled with patchy, scale-like chromatophore plates that ripple to match surroundings, and two golden, independently-rotating eyes peer from a broad head under a shadow mask like a falcon’s; overall colors range from icy blue-grays and snow-white to sea-sheen blacks and moss greens, with wet-gloss ink highlights around the tentacles and throat.
record.fun_fact: It can vanish into the snowy rocks by turning its fur white, then drop from the sky like a surprise snow-storm to grab things with its sticky tentacles!

record.name: Camo-Tusk Skykraken
record.title: The Phantom Cloud Hunter
record.anatomy_plan: It has a huge body covered in thick, color-changing fur, giant falcon wings for flying, a sharp beak flanked by mammoth tusks, and eight long tentacles instead of legs for grabbing.

abilities.name: Meteor Grab
abilities.blurb: Dives from the sky at super speed to snatch up food with its eight fuzzy tentacles!

abilities.name: Cloud Cloak
abilities.blurb: Its thick fluffy fur changes color to make it completely invisible against the sky and snow.

abilities.name: Freezing Ink-Storm
abilities.blurb: Blasts a giant cloud of freezing black snow to blind bad guys and fly away safely!

strengths: Super fast dives from the sky
Can grab things from super far away
weaknesses: Walks very slowly and clumsily on the ground
Thick fur makes it overheat quickly in deserts
A huge target if caught hovering in one place
record.visual_spec: A gigantic flying beast with massive falcon wings and a sharp beak placed between two giant curved mammoth tusks. Its body is covered in thick, fluffy fur that ripples with chameleon colors. Eight long, fuzzy tentacles trail beneath it, ending in sharp falcon talons.
record.fun_fact: It can change its fur color to look exactly like a giant floating thundercloud to scare off other monsters!
